title: ShiftPlanProposed CloudEvent
description: CloudEvent for a proposed, not-yet-committed headcount figure for one path.

allOf.title: CloudEvents 1.0 context attributes
allOf.description:
The CloudEvents 1.0 structured-mode context attributes shared by
every message (ADR-0026). Every attribute is REQUIRED. Each event
schema below composes this base with an `allOf` and pins its own
`type` const and `dataschema` const.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Always "1.0" on this channel.

id.description:
Unique identifier of this event occurrence, a UUID v4 minted once
by the publisher and persisted with the outbox row, so a
redelivery carries the same id. `(source, id)` is the consumer
idempotency key.

subject.description:
Identifier of the aggregate instance this occurrence is about —
an associate id, a path id, or a `buildingId/shiftId` pair. Never
empty.

time.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred in the domain.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the `data` member. Always "application/json".

dataschema.description:
Absolute URI naming the payload shape,
`urn:warehouse:workforce-management:<events|analytics>:<EventName>:v<N>`.

data.description: The computed proposal for one path, ahead of a human commit.

site_code.description:
Canonical name of the shift-plan key (ADR 0035): the Site
code the proposal was computed for. Carries the SAME
value as `building_id`. Added after v1 shipped, so it is
deliberately not `required`; consumers must fall back to
`building_id` when it is absent.

building_id.description:
DEPRECATED -- use `site_code`; same value. Kept, not
removed (additive change, no `.v2`); removal needs a later
breaking ADR. Site the proposal was computed for.

path_id.description: Process path the heads were proposed for.

planned_heads.description: Proposed heads, computed as ceil(charge / plannedRate).

planned_rate.description: Planned units per hour per head used in the computation.
